meta.title: Immersive Analytics Workspace
meta.description: Immersive analytics workspace that transforms prompts into living insights, narratives, and decisions.

sections.title: Turn your raw data into trust worthy insights, faster than ever.
sections.lead:
The workspace blends dialogue with governed execution. Every prompt activates FastAPI endpoints that orchestrate connectors,
in-memory transformations, async worker jobs, and curated visual templates—so you can move from questions to reliable briefings in minutes,
regardless of file type or upstream system.

stats.label: Prompt to plan
stats.body: Guided steps to move from question to analysis.

stats.label: Reusable playbooks
stats.body: Kick off with templates tuned to your domain.

stats.label: Format agnostic
stats.body: Built to reason across tabular data, documents, and APIs—if Python can reach the source, the companion treats it as first-class.

panel.title: An LLM that coaches, not just answers.
panel.body:
Each conversation keeps its context, from uploaded files and notebooks to API payloads, scraped web content, and generated visuals.
The assistant narrates reasoning, suggests next steps, and packages outcomes in the language your team already relies on—while safety guardrails keep recommendations dependable.

features.title: Guided hypotheses
features.body: Prompt templates align the LLM with your domain, steering it toward measurable outcomes and guardrails.

features.title: System orchestration
features.body: Secure APIs broker dataset access, webhook calls, cost tracking, and user context. Role-aware policies and audit logs keep every response safe and reproducible.

features.title: Transformation engine
features.body: Lightweight models unify CSVs, Parquet, REST responses, and semi-structured documents so you can storyboard any dataset in milliseconds.

features.title: Worker escalations
features.body: Async tasks enrich results—fetching external context, refreshing partner APIs, crawling authorised pages, or syncing summaries downstream—while resilience checks and cost guards prevent surprises.

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.body: “Diagnose the dip in usage for premium customers and craft steps to stabilise churn before Q3 renewals.”

response.label: Companion response
response.body:
1. **Intake & safeguards.** Verified role permissions, scanned uploaded CSV and PDF decks, pulled customer health via CRM API, and logged the request with cost and data-lineage tags.
2. **Multi-step analysis.** Workers profiled churn indicators, ran statistical comparisons, and generated correlation visuals. The LLM streamed interim findings so you could steer in real time.
3. **Narrative & assets.** Composed a briefing that pairs metrics, annotated trend images, and a rationale outlining assumptions, limitations, and next best experiments.
4. **Delivery.** Scheduled a refresh job, pushed action items to the control tower, and stored the conversation—ensuring the final response remains auditable and safely reproducible.

quote.label: Field note
quote.body: “It feels like pairing with a staff analyst who remembers every run and keeps nudging us toward measurable outcomes.”
